scope: Selected bounded complete fixed-record NetFlow v5 UDP observations and explicit partial malformed-clock views. Static legacy leaf preserved, catalog partial. No complete NetFlow/IPFIX or global protocol acceptance claim.

policy.automatic: Complete v5 fixed-record grammar plus UDP2055/2056/9995/9996 service hint; a port or two-field prefix alone never confirms the message. Nondefault profiles require explicit Decode-As.
policy.structure: 24-byte header; selected1..30 records of exactly48 bytes each; all scalar/address/padding fields retained with exact logical PDU spans; no trailing bytes.
policy.collection_limit: 19 collection units per record, maximum570 for selected30-record profile; no unbounded list or zero-width state.
policy.context: Each message is independent. Packet loss/reorder, sequence wrapping, exact duplicates and engine reuse never inherit another export record or allocate captured TCP flows/transactions. V5 sequence counts reported flows, unlike v9 export packets.
policy.clock: Residual nanoseconds>=1000000000 on an otherwise complete carrier/layout yields retained literal fields with malformed status, Export Timestamp Valid=false and explicit failure; no normalized absolute timestamp. Stateless canonical and legacy rule entry still return an error. Bad carriers never reach this confirmation path.
policy.scope: Reported IPv4 addresses, ports, AS/interfaces, flow counters and TCP flags describe exported observations. They do not replace the captured collector endpoints or imply authenticated exporters, delivery, active connections or absolute uptime-derived timestamps.
policy.conformance: Unassigned sampling mode, unused nonzero padding and masks>32 retain literal values and warnings; no invented prefix.
policy.field_registry: Additive owned Protocols metadata enumerates actual shared bindings while legacy Protocol primary remains compatible; text listing includes both v5/v9. Private scalar values and namespaces remain scoped.

upstream_positive.provenance: Pinned upstream project capture; not a new live capture or independent guarantee of the original traffic generator.
upstream_positive.supplementary_selection: Both implementations explicitly decode UDP port9990 as NetFlow/cflow v5. The original default omission remains visible.
